describes: Where this paper actually lives, for citation purposes.
note: This exists so no component ever hardcodes a URL. A citation is the one place a wrong address does real damage: it sends a reader somewhere that does not exist and cannot be corrected after the fact.
url_note: The project is hosted on a platform subdomain. A permanent domain has not been registered, so this address may change; cite the corpus id and access date alongside it.
